holdings.name: Coforge Ltd

what_changed.text: Coforge launched an intent engineering framework for enterprise AI agents and announced the expansion of its Kraków AI engineering center to exceed 660 employees by 2027.
HDFC Mutual Fund reduced its stake in Coforge to 4.30% on October 6, 2026.
Sales grew to ₹5,528 crore in the June 2026 quarter from ₹4,450 crore in the March 2026 quarter, while net profit came in at ₹532 crore compared to ₹666 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 3.01% allocation, Coforge is the top holding in the fund and the single largest 3-month positive contributor (+0.885% contribution via a 29.40% return).

watch.text: Financial results for Q2 and H1 FY2027 scheduled for release around the analyst call on October 23, 2026.

holdings.name: AU Small Finance Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Provisional Q2 FY27 business updates indicated deposits rose 28.6% year-on-year to ₹1.70 lakh crore and gross loan portfolio increased 25.1%.

holdings.why_it_matters: AU Small Finance Bank is the fund's second-largest holding at 2.75% weight and forms part of the fund's largest sector exposure (Financials at 22.8%). The stock lost 3.96% over the last 3 months.

watch.text: Approval of unaudited financial results for Q2 and H1 FY27 at the board meeting on October 24, 2026.

holdings.name: Blue Star Ltd

what_changed.text: Blue Star initiated the strike-off of its non-operational Ugandan subsidiary BS AC&R UL, expected to finish by March 31, 2027.
Operating profit margin compressed to 5% in the June 2026 quarter compared to 8% in the preceding quarter, with sales declining from ₹4,072 crore to ₹3,378 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Blue Star holds a 2.55% weight in the portfolio and was among the top bottom contributors over 3 months (-0.18% contribution on a -7.07% return).

watch.text: Board meeting on October 29, 2026 to approve Q2 and half-year financial results.

holdings.name: Aurobindo Pharma Ltd

what_changed.text: Aurobindo received final USFDA approval for Perampanel Tablets, with commercial launch scheduled for Q3 FY27.
Subsidiary Apitoria completed the acquisition of A1 Labs LLC and an 80% stake in A1 Labs India for USD 15.247 million.
Revenue reached ₹9,150 crore in the June 2026 quarter with operating margin at 21% and net profit of ₹1,032 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 2.24% portfolio weight, Aurobindo contributed +0.195% over the last 3 months with an 8.71% return, supporting the Healthcare sector allocation (12.4%).

watch.text: Commercial launch of Perampanel Tablets in the US during Q3 FY27.

holdings.name: Ajanta Pharma Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit for the June 2026 quarter climbed to ₹334 crore on revenue of ₹1,626 crore, up from ₹267 crore and ₹1,422 crore respectively in the March 2026 quarter.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 2.15% fund weight, Ajanta Pharma reinforces the fund's 12.4% healthcare position; the stock contracted 2.90% over 3 months despite a 19.00% 6-month gain.

watch.text: Board meeting on October 30, 2026 to consider and approve Q2 FY27 results.

holdings.name: APL Apollo Tubes Ltd

what_changed.text: APL Apollo reported record Q2 FY27 sales volume of 963,143 tonnes, reflecting a 13% YoY and 29% QoQ increase.
The company implemented product price increases, with further hikes effective October 1, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: APL Apollo holds a 2.11% weight and provided the second-highest 3-month positive contribution (+0.42% via a 19.90% stock return) within the 21.2% Industrials basket.

watch.text: Realization trends and capacity absorption following the October product price hikes.

holdings.name: The Federal Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Federal Bank reported Q2 FY27 net profit of ₹1,386 crore (up 45%) with total business crossing ₹6.4 lakh crore, while quarterly revenue stood at ₹8,383 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: At 1.98% weight, Federal Bank is an anchor position in the fund's 22.8% Financials sector, delivering a 1-year return of 57.58% despite a -3.15% drag over the last 3 months.

watch.text: Investor presentation updates and performance metrics following the October 16, 2026 board meeting outcome.

holdings.name: Phoenix Mills Ltd

what_changed.text: The company approved the amalgamation of subsidiaries SGH Realty and Truevalue Infrabuild, subject to NCLT and RD approvals.
The company discontinued publishing standalone quarterly operational business updates starting Q2 FY27, shifting disclosures directly to quarterly result releases.

holdings.why_it_matters: Phoenix Mills represents 1.95% of the portfolio, accounting for the bulk of the fund's 3.1% Real Estate exposure; the stock declined 8.62% over 3 months.

watch.text: Regulatory and NCLT approval timelines for the subsidiary merger.

holdings.name: Info Edge (India) Ltd

what_changed.text: Reported standalone Q2 FY27 billings rose 12.8% year-on-year to ₹822.3 crore, bringing H1 billings growth to 13.5%.
The board approved an aggregate ₹200 crore investment across two wholly owned subsidiaries, SISL and SIHL.

holdings.why_it_matters: Accounting for 1.92% of the fund, Info Edge supports the 11.0% Technology exposure and delivered a 6.56% gain over the past 3 months.

watch.text: Execution and capital deployment into SISL and SIHL following board approval.

holdings.name: Shriram Transport Finance Company Ltd

what_changed.text: The company publicly refuted media reports regarding MUFG seeking a majority control stake.
June 2026 quarter revenue rose to ₹13,400 crore with net profit touching ₹3,453 crore, compared to ₹12,513 crore and ₹3,021 crore in the March 2026 quarter.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 1.92% portfolio weight, Shriram Finance declined 9.17% over the last 3 months, weighing on Financials performance.

watch.text: Board meeting scheduled for October 23, 2026 to review Q2 results, consider an interim dividend, and evaluate debt fundraising.

portfolio.statement: UTI Mid Cap Fund returned -2.72% over 3 months and -2.18% over 1 month, with positive returns from technology and manufacturing offset by declines across financials and industrials.
interp: The fund maintains a high equity allocation of 96.7% across 11,920 crore in AUM, with sector concentration focused in Financials (22.8%) and Industrials (21.2%).
Top-line 3-month performance was supported by IT and steel tube volume growth, but weighed down by consumer finance, fintech, and power generation holdings.
portfolio.line: Sector divergence defined recent fund performance, as technology gains failed to counterbalance broad corrections in financials and capital goods.

drivers.text: Coforge generated a 29.40% 3-month return, contributing +0.885% to the portfolio following AI product launches and expansion announcements.
APL Apollo Tubes added +0.420% to performance via a 19.90% return, aided by a record 9.63 lakh tonnes in Q2 sales volume.
Weakness across financial holdings, including a 32.02% drop in PB Fintech and a 9.17% drop in Shriram Finance, detracted heavily from fund returns.

themes.title: Enterprise AI and Digital Engineering
themes.text: Portfolio IT holdings are allocating capital toward proprietary AI frameworks and overseas delivery centers.

themes.title: Manufacturing Volume Scaling
themes.text: Industrial leaders demonstrated double-digit volume expansion and capacity price adjustments despite broader manufacturing margin moderation.

macro.factor: Banking Credit and Deposit Growth Cycles
macro.why: Deposit competition and gross loan book expansions directly impact net interest margins and funding costs for the fund's primary sector.
Manufacturing and structural tube companies face shifting raw material dynamics requiring product price hikes to preserve operating margins.

priced_in.text: APL Apollo's record Q2 sales volumes of 9.63 lakh tonnes and announced price hikes appear priced into its 19.90% 3-month share price rally.
Strong Q2 operational billings growth of 12.8% at Info Edge is reflected in its recent positive monthly momentum.

could_change.title: Commercial Execution of US Generics and Speciality Pharma
could_change.text: Timely launches of newly approved products like Perampanel Tablets will determine whether healthcare holdings sustain recent margin gains.

could_change.title: Subsidiary Amalgamation Outcomes
could_change.text: Court and regulatory sanctions for operational mergers across real estate holdings could determine overhead cost reductions.

portfolio.risk_note: The fund shows high maximum drawdown (-22.66%) and annualized volatility of 16.31% with a Sharpe ratio of 0.25, reflecting elevated mid-cap price swings across shifting industry cycles.
